B.LEAGUE Shots

Source: R/bleague.R
bleague_shots.Rd

Field-goal attempts of one B.LEAGUE game with their court position (play-by-play rows that carry x / y).

Endpoint: GET https://b-league.s3.amazonaws.com/web_json/v2_genius_contexts/{schedule_key}/{latest}.json (the v1 feed, or the game page's embed, when v2 does not hold the game).

One row per field-goal attempt (ActionCD1 1-6) with a location, oldest first. x is the percent (0-100) of the court LENGTH from the left baseline and y the percent of the WIDTH (the baskets sit near x = 5 and 95 at y = 50). Which sideline is y = 0 is unverified, and metres (x / 100 x 28, y / 100 x 15) are an inference. side (left / right) names the basket a shot is charted at, from 2025-26 only; teams change ends at half-time. in_paint is NA on the B3 feed. Locations exist from 2022-23 on the v2 feed only: any other game gives a zero-row tibble.

Usage

bleague_shots(schedule_key, season = NULL)

Arguments

schedule_key

(integer required): B.LEAGUE ScheduleKey, one global sequence across B1, B2, B3 and every season, e.g. 504734 (B1 2025-26 sec 1, Alvark Tokyo v Utsunomiya Brex); the schedule_key column of bleague_schedule().

season

(integer optional): a guard, the season END year the game must belong to; a context whose Year differs raises hoopR_asset_fetch. NULL (default) = no check (the key alone selects the game).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
schedule_keyintegerB.LEAGUE ScheduleKey (key space: B.LEAGUE games, ONE global integer sequence across B1, B2, B3 and every season). The {schedule_key} every game wrapper takes and the schedule page's list-item id.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26), the feed's Year (the START year) plus one.
feedcharacterSource feed of the row: v2 (v2_genius_contexts, B1/B2 from 2020-21) or v1 (v1_contexts: B3, B1/B2 2018-2020, and the 2016-17 / 2017-18 game-page embed). The feeds differ in id types, dates and some codes.
periodintegerPeriod number: 1-4 regulation; overtime numbering is unverified (no overtime sample).
event_nointegerEvent sequence number, ascending in game order. v2 counts in steps of 1000 (inserted corrections may fall in between); v1 counts 1, 2, 3...
team_sidecharacterSide of the acting team from HomeAway (1 home, 2 away); null on game-level rows and official timeouts.
team_idcharacterB.LEAGUE TeamID as text (key space: B.LEAGUE clubs, stable across seasons AND club renames: 703 = Tochigi Brex in 2016-17 = Utsunomiya Brex in 2025-26). The feed sends a string on v2 and an integer on v1; both are text here. Not a player id.
player_idcharacterPrimary actor PlayerID as text (key space: B.LEAGUE persons). On a v1 substitution it is the player going out. Null on team rows and game-level rows.
player_nocharacterShirt number as text, so '00' and '0' stay distinct; null on team and game-level rows.
player_name_jcharacterPlayer name in Japanese (katakana for foreign players); null on team and game-level rows.
shot_typecharacter3pt or 2pt, from ActionCD1 (1-2 three-point, 3-6 two-point).
in_paintlogicalTrue for a two-point shot inside the paint, false outside; null for threes and on the B3 feed, whose 2PT codes do not split by paint.
madelogicalTrue when the shot was made (ActionCD1 odd for threes and 3 / 4), false when missed.
qualifier2characterEnglish slug for the shot's ActionCD2 (jump_shot, layup, dunk); null when unknown.
qualifier3characterEnglish slug for the shot's ActionCD3 (fast_break, points_off_turnover, second_chance, ...); null when none.
xdoubleEvent x: percent (0-100) of the court LENGTH from the 'left' baseline (baskets near 5 and 95). Metres (x / 100 x 28) are an inference. 2022-23 onward on v2 only.
ydoubleEvent y: percent (0-100) of the court WIDTH (baskets at 50). Which sideline is y = 0 is unverified; metres (y / 100 x 15) are an inference. 2022-23 onward on v2 only.
area_codeintegerShot-zone code 1-13 read from the site's shot-chart SVG: 1 restricted area, 2 rest of the paint, 3 / 7 baseline mid-range, 4 / 6 wing mid-range, 5 top-of-the-key mid-range, 8 / 12 corner 3, 9 / 11 wing 3, 10 top 3, 13 deep band. Of each pair the first is the side far along the baseline. Also set on turnover and foul rows; 2022-23 onward.
areacharacterEnglish zone slug for area_code (restricted_area, paint, baseline_mid_range, wing_mid_range, top_of_key_mid_range, corner_3, wing_3, top_3, deep_3); mirrored codes share a slug.
sidecharacterBasket the play is charted at: 'left' (x near 0) or 'right' (x near 100); flips at half-time. Present from 2025-26 only; earlier seasons leave it null and the end must be inferred from x.
rest_timecharacterGame clock REMAINING in the period as the feed's 'mm:ss' text (counts down from 10:00).
clock_secondsintegerGame clock remaining in the period in whole seconds (8:50 = 530), derived from rest_time.
scorecharacterRunning score 'home-away' after the event (e.g. '2-4'); null on player-in rows and v1 substitutions.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in bleague_game_info().
